messages:
marie (AE): Heads up — C-suite at HelioCore requested a short on-prem POC timeline. They want committed reserved capacity pricing and a SOC2 + KMS attestation. If we can't commit by EOW they want an exec bridge.

jason (SE): Got it. What throughput and p95 latency are they expecting? Any hard data residency constraints?

marie (AE): Target is ~50 rps sustained, 150 rps peak, p95 < 200ms on short prompts. Data must remain in EU for the initial pilot.

elena (Eng-Infra): 50 rps sustained is doable on Dedicated but depends on GPU type and KV placement. We'll need sequence length distribution and sample payloads to size nodes. Also: do they require BYOK?

jason (SE): I'll produce a traffic sketch and sample payloads. Note: quantization profile will affect latency; recommend starting with A10G-class nodes.

sam (CS): Legal/compliance queue: KMS attestation + SOC2 checks are typically ~5 business days. We can attempt an expedited path but need a signed CDA and the dataflow diagram.

rachel (Legal): We can prioritize after CDA and a concrete list of who holds keys (customer BYOK vs Redwood-managed). Also need to know required log retention and any specific certs for egress endpoints.

marie (AE): @rachel — we'll push HelioCore to sign the CDA today. Customer is open to BYOK. Can you draft an engineers-facing checklist we can present at kickoff?

rachel (Legal): Drafting now. Initial checklist: 1) CDA signed, 2) KMS ownership decision, 3) network peering + CIDR, 4) log types + retention, 5) cert + TLS endpoints, 6) data classification. I'll attach a short doc once ready.

deploy-bot: incident-bot: all services nominal. No active incidents.

elena (Eng-Infra): Operational note — for EU Dedicated with canary + fallback to hosted variant we need a route policy and a warm-up plan. Quick runbook snippet for the SEs/ops:

```
Runbook (brief):
1) set-route-policy --from=hosted --to=dedicated-eu --policy=canary
2) provision-nodes --gpu=a10g --replicas=2 --region=eu-west-1
3) warm-kv --corpus=sample_prompts --duration=10m
4) smoke-test: curl -X POST https://api.redwood/sync/generate -d '{"prompt":"<sample>","max_tokens":128}'
5) monitor: token-cost + p95 latency -> alert if p95 > 250ms
```

jason (SE): Thanks — I'll attach perf payloads and a seq-length histogram by EOD. Also will include curl examples for smoke.

marie (AE): Customer asked about pricing: they want a 3-month reserved commit with a 20% discount. Ops/Rev, is that doable?

priya (RevOps): 20% for 3 months is above standard. Typical allowance is ~10% for short commits. For 20% we'd need exec signoff or a larger committed spend. Suggest offering 12% + onboarding credit to close quickly. I'll prepare a comparison table.

sam (CS): I'll update the POC checklist in the deal doc to reflect the CDA + credit path.

marie (AE): Quick next-steps summary for the thread: @jason -> sample traffic + perf targets by EOD; @elena -> resource estimate + runbook by tomorrow noon UTC; @priya -> pricing slide deck draft by tomorrow afternoon; @rachel -> checklist & short CDA addendum asap. If CDA not signed by Friday escalate to exec bridge (requesting @noah presence).

elena (Eng-Infra): ETA: sizing & runbook tomorrow 12:00 UTC. I'll include node counts and a fallback play.

priya (RevOps): ETA: pricing deck draft and margin scenarios tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

jason (SE): Payloads and perf sketches out tonight.

marie (AE): Thanks all. If we hit legal delay, I'll open the exec bridge. cc @noah (CTO) for visibility.

noah (CTO): Noted — I can join the bridge Monday morning if needed. Keep me posted.

marie (AE): Copy. I'll post updates here as things move. :thumbsup:
